start: Owner online, member app on, no branding yet, Settings > Branding

user_sees: Title 'Branding', 'Your gym's logo and colours in the MettleUp app. Your logo also shows at the top of this admin app.'
'Your brand colour', 'Background tone', heading style 'Normal' / 'Bold italic', a phone preview and a shortcut preview
must_not: Another gym's logo or colours
Save enabled before anything changed

steps.action: Upload a PNG logo that sits on a plain white box
user_sees: 'Checking your logo…' then a choice 'Without the background' ('Best for the app') or 'Keep my logo as it is'
'Upload this logo' then 'Uploading…'
The logo in the phone preview
must_not: The logo shown to members before Save
A huge file uploaded untrimmed

steps.action: Pick a brand colour and tap 'Save'
user_sees: 'Saving…'
Toast 'Saved. New members see it at once. Members who already joined see it on a later visit to the app. The app checks at most once an hour, and never in the middle of a workout.'
'Saved · <day month>'
The logo at the top of the admin app at once
must_not: The saved colour differs from the picked one
A member mid-workout sees the look change
Save twice from a double tap

start: Owner opens Branding from Set up your gym, logo has a photo behind it

steps.action: Upload a logo with a photo or pattern background
user_sees: 'Your logo has a photo or a pattern behind it.' 'We can only take off a plain background, so we kept your logo as it is. … You can remove it for free:' with three steps (ChatGPT or Google Gemini)
must_not: A half-erased logo used
The upload refused with no way on

user_sees: The Set up your gym step for branding is ticked
must_not: The step ticked before a save

start: Branding, owner tries bad input; and a gym with the member app off

steps.action: Pick a file that is not a readable picture
user_sees: 'This picture can’t be read here. Save the logo as PNG and try again.' or 'That logo could not be used. Try a PNG or JPEG picture.'
must_not: The old logo removed
A broken picture saved

user_sees: 'Finish typing the colour code to check it.' and Save stays off
must_not: A broken colour saved

steps.action: Pick a very dark brand colour
user_sees: Card 'Easy to read?' and 'Members see the changed colour, so it is easy to read. Save keeps the colour you picked.'
must_not: Unreadable text in the member app
The picked colour replaced in the saved record

steps.action: In a gym whose member app is off, open Settings > Branding
user_sees: Card 'Turn on the member app first'
must_not: A branding form that cannot save

start: Owner with a saved logo and colours

user_sees: Sheet 'Go back to MettleUp’s look?' 'This removes your logo and colours from the member app. Members see MettleUp’s look on a later visit to the app, never in the middle of a workout.' with 'Keep my look' and 'Use MettleUp’s look'
must_not: Removed before confirming

user_sees: Toast 'Back to MettleUp’s look.'
The form back to defaults; the admin app header shows no gym logo
must_not: The old logo still served to members after their next check
The 'Use MettleUp’s look' button still there

steps.action: Upload the logo again and save
user_sees: Saved as new
must_not: The old colours come back by themselves

start: A front desk login types the address /settings/branding

user_sees: 'Only an owner can see this' 'Ask your gym owner if you need something from here.'
must_not: The form shown read-only with the owner's draft
A save from the desk accepted by the server

user_sees: The logo is a file anyone with its address can load (it is shown in the member app)
must_not: Any personal data in the logo address or file name
